description: Cohere-compatible embed — Drop-in Cohere v1 /embed endpoint (bge-base-en-v1.5, 768 dims): body {texts:[...up to 96], input_type: search_document|search_query|classification|clustering, truncate: END|START|NONE, embedding_types: [float,int8,uint8,binary,ubinary]}. search_query adds the BGE retrieval instruction automatically. Returns {id, texts, embeddings, meta.billed_units, response_type} exactly like Cohere (embeddings_floats, or embeddings_by_type when embedding_types is sent; int8/uint8 are per-vector scaled, binary/ubinary pack sign bits 8 per byte). Also accepts input/inputs. Text only. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
